fact: The 2020 yearbook states that monthly facility reports are entered in DHIS2 at health-centre, district and hospital level, and gives a 98.9 per cent report completeness and 91.0 per cent timeliness for health centres in 2020.
title: Annuaire des statistiques sanitaires 2020
publisher: Ministère de la Santé Publique et de la Lutte contre le SIDA, DSNIS
